This role will provide exposure to ownership of development, testing, deployment support and troubleshooting over time.

Develop and maintain integrations of moderate complexity independently using C#, .NET, REST APIs, XML, JSON, Entity Framework, LINQ and SQL.
Clarify integration requirements, API contracts, data mappings, validations and expected system behavior by taking an active part in story grooming and technical discussions.
Develop, consume, and validate REST APIs, applying knowledge of HTTP methods, request and response structures, status codes, authentication concepts, headers and error handling.
Use Postman to test different payloads, analyze API responses and troubleshoot integration failures.
Work with XML and JSON data structures, mappings, transformations and validation, and troubleshoot malformed or unexpected data.
Apply Entity Framework and LINQ for application data access, querying and manipulation

Use Azure DevOps for CI/CD activities, builds, deployments, work tracking and troubleshooting basic pipeline or deployment issues.
Understand and make basic React frontend changes when integration functionality requires matching UI updates.
Manage assigned Jira tickets and follow issues through development, testing and deployment.
Take part in peer code reviews, applying coding, security, maintainability and integration best practices.
Build knowledge of core product and integration workflows and the business domain.
Support critical production issues, deployments and business-critical activities during occasional weekends or off-hours, as needed.

3+ years of software development or integration engineering experience, preferably involving API-based and enterprise application integrations
Strong working knowledge of C#, .NET, object-oriented programming and common design principles
Hands-on experience developing and consuming REST APIs, with an understanding of API error handling, logging, validation, authentication, configuration management and reusable integration practices
Strong working knowledge of XML and JSON, including parsing, validation, data mapping and troubleshooting payload-related issues
Good working knowledge of SQL, including joins, filtering, data validation and troubleshooting application or integration-related data issues
Experience using Postman for API testing, request configuration, payload validation, authentication and response analysis
Solid understanding of Git, including branching, commits, pull requests, merging and resolving basic merge conflicts
Agile and Scrum processes, sprint planning, story grooming and iterative software delivery
Strong problem-solving skills, and able to trace failures across systems rather than focusing only on individual application components. This includes troubleshooting across the API, application code, XML and JSON payload, database, configuration and deployment layers
Able to work with the Product, QA, DevOps, Integration and Support Teams to investigate and resolve end-to-end integration issues
Willingness to work occasional weekends or off-hours on rotation, as required.
